title: Appeal 45/3/160: accommodation stair in completed visitors-centre work; relaxation of Requirement K1 refused
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2000 (as amended): Requirement K1 (stairs, ladders and ramps)

facts.text: The appeal under section 39 is against the Borough Council's refusal to relax Requirement K1 for a stair forming part of completed building work at a visitors centre.
The appeal relates to completed building work and the design of what is described as an accommodation stair in a visitors' centre.
The Secretary of State would not normally consider it appropriate to relax Requirement K1 except in exceptional circumstances, and finds none in this case.
